messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [Relocation > Relocation / Address Change > Importance of Communicating Location > Long-Term Relocation > Considerations and Eligibility]
1. If you are considering applying for a long-term relocation to a new country, the first consideration is to ensure that GitLab has an [entity](/handbook/people-group/employment-solutions/#gitlab-entities-and-branches) in the country to which you would like to move.  We currently only support relocations to GitLab Entities that are open for hiring and do not have hiring restrictions or headcount caps.  This is in alignment with our [Country hiring guidelines](/handbook/people-group/employment-solutions/#country-hiring-guidelines).
1. Consider any changes to [benefits](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/) as benefits can vary by country.
1. You must have the appropriate right to work documentation/visa requirements in the country that you are considering relocating to.

- Please note, at this moment GitLab only sponsors [relocations to the Netherlands](/handbook/people-group/visas/#right-to-immigrate-to-the-netherlands) and doesn't cover relocation costs for the team member's family members also looking to relocate.

1. You must have satisfied the required one year tenure to be eligible for relocation.

[2] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Financial Wellbeing Support]
GitLab's Netherlands pension provider, a.s.r., partners with Geldfit, a free and anonymous financial wellbeing service available to all Netherlands-based team members.
Geldfit can help you with:

* Questions about money and your financial situation
* Insights and practical tools to support your financial health
* Guidance on available support options

[Get started (Dutch language)](https://geldfit.nl/welkom/asrzakelijk)

[3] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Life Insurance and Disability]
GitLab provides company-paid Group Life and Disability Plans through Generali to protect you and your loved ones during unexpected life events. This comprehensive coverage ensures financial security when you need it most.

Eligibility Requirements

- All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
- Coverage effective from your hire date (90-day waiting period)

Coverage & Key Features

- Life Insurance coverage
- Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) benefits
- Short-term and Long-term Disability protection
- 100% employer-paid premiums
- [View complete plan details](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MBz0k5KkXC2GeITvh2uXNXjMJE07TU3_9MTp8N9MlwM/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.uewazgm9e8qx) and [policy documents](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jNFYcn2CLWHpPolvGTEz21FCQKIYBsbq/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access

Question: If I move from GitLab France S.A.S. to GitLab BV in the Netherlands, how does the life insurance coverage differ between the two entities?
